as_told.title: Puthoff's Physical Review paper on gravity

plain: The physicist Hal Puthoff says he has a way of describing gravity as empty space changing its properties, which he calls the polarizable vacuum approach, and that in a paper he published in a physics journal it reproduces "all of the tests of general relativity," Einstein's theory of gravity. A Navy scientist named Salvatore Pais, who holds patents on unusual craft, praises the same work on another episode, naming the journal as Physical Review and calling the gravity paper "deserving of a Nobel prize." If it holds, gravity could be treated as something engineers might one day adjust.
